notes.title: New Roguelike Mode Now Available!
notes.content: [h2]This update introduces a brand-new roguelike mode:[/h2][p][/p][h3]· Try different equipment combos for diverse combat![/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45603031/c013c260f39aecd384bc5559d831bfea1953924e.png"][/img][/p][h3]· Intense roguelike action against dragon assaults[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45603031/9401f32cf2846d0509857abbfa66c05b000137c3.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45603031/26cc658c636a711b31a3e4a2478d4641d1dafba6.png"][/img][/p][h3]· Summon Guardians to join your battle![/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45603031/3bf1eff7884fa1d8700124e2b44e9a1e859f6d3b.png"][/img][/p][h3]· 20+ new achievements - test your skills![/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45603031/864d89340aaa3c726dfb537a971b3808b2d5f18d.png"][/img][/p]
